The test image shows a very young seedling lying on wet, dark soil with yellowed/tan cotyledons showing dark spots, appearing collapsed at soil level — classic damping-off presentation.

The Pythium damping-off reference images match well: seedlings at soil line on dark wet soil, cotyledons deteriorating, plants unable to stand. The tan/brown discoloration of cotyledons matches the progression from water-soaked to brown soft rot described for Pythium.
